title: Rename the 2 duplicate-named test pairs inside crossref_filter_test.dart's 'Companion.toColumns with id present' group
rule: naming hygiene / Fowler duplication (copy-paste without rename)
why: Both pairs sit in the same group() with identical printed names but different fixtures (the second CompletionEventsCompanion test drops trackId; the second StreakEventsCompanion test adds eventType/dayUtc). Confirmed live in this session's `flutter test` run of this file: the output lines '+13'/'+14' and '+18'/'+19' print the exact same fully-qualified name twice, so `dart test -n '<name>'` can't select just one, CI failure reports can't disambiguate which fixture broke, and a future reader can't tell from the test list that two different cases exist.
recommendation: Rename the second test in each pair to state what varies, e.g. 'CompletionEventsCompanion id present in toColumns (no trackId)' and 'StreakEventsCompanion id present in toColumns (with eventType/dayUtc)'.
acceptance_criteria: No two test('...') description strings are identical within the same group() in this file.
